posts.text: New product launch (Automated Extraction System) from company’s LinkedIn - MICROCON was the first event where we showcased TRUElute®, our compact automated nucleic acid extraction system. It’s built on magnetic bead technology and designed to take the manual steps out of extraction: 1 to 16 samples per run 20 to 1100 µl processing volume Built-in heating for lysis and elution 7-inch touchscreen, UV sterilization and easy calibration Works with TRUPCR® extraction kits and Real-Time PCR kits One workflow, from sample to report TRUElute® completes our molecular workflow.
